items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Adobe Illustrator enables arbitrary code execution when users open crafted files, representing a high-risk threat to desktop workstations.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Illustrator 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞在用户打开特制文件时可导致任意代码执行，对桌面工作站构成高风险威胁。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free flaw in Acrobat Reader allows remote code execution upon opening malicious PDFs, directly impacting end-user desktop environments.
items.reason_zh: Acrobat Reader 中的释放后使用缺陷可在打开恶意 PDF 时允许远程代码执行，直接影响终端用户的桌面环境。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in Windows GDI+ allows local attackers to execute arbitrary code or escalate privileges by exploiting memory corruption in a core graphics subsystem.
items.reason_zh: Windows GDI+ 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许本地攻击者通过利用核心图形子系统中的内存损坏来执行任意代码或提升权限。

items.reason_en: An out-of-bounds write vulnerability in .NET enables unauthorized local code execution, posing a direct threat to desktop environments relying on managed runtime environments.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中的越界写入漏洞可启用未授权的本地代码执行，对依赖托管运行时的桌面环境构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Excel can be triggered by malicious documents, allowing local attackers to execute code and compromise end-user workstations.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Excel 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可由恶意文档触发，使本地攻击者能够执行代码并破坏终端用户工作站。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office allows local code execution. Its high prevalence makes it a prime target for phishing campaigns delivering malicious documents.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许本地代码执行。其高发性使其成为投递恶意文档的网络钓鱼活动的重点目标。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Word enables unauthorized local code execution via crafted files. This poses a significant risk to end-users opening untrusted attachments.
items.reason_zh: Word 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过特制文件实现未授权的本地代码执行。这对打开不受信任附件的终端用户构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the Remote Desktop Client permits remote code execution over a network. Attackers can exploit this to gain full control of targeted endpoints without user interaction.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行。攻击者可利用此漏洞在无需用户交互的情况下完全控制目标端点。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Kerberos allows local privilege escalation. Compromising this service grants attackers domain-level administrative access.
items.reason_zh: Windows Kerberos 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许本地权限提升。攻破该服务将使攻击者获得域级管理员访问权限。

items.reason_en: Improper link resolution in the Accessibility Infrastructure enables local privilege escalation with a notably high EPSS score (0.0368). This indicates strong real-world exploitation potential against accessibility features.
items.reason_zh: Accessibility Infrastructure 中的链接解析不当漏洞可导致本地权限提升，且 EPSS 评分显著偏高（0.0368）。这表明针对辅助功能特性的实际利用潜力较强。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Win32K allows authorized users to escalate privileges locally. As a core graphics subsystem component, it remains a frequent target for kernel exploits.
items.reason_zh: Win32K 中的释放后使用漏洞允许授权用户进行本地权限提升。作为核心图形子系统组件，它仍是内核漏洞利用的常见目标。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Excel allows unauthorized local code execution, posing a direct threat to end-user workstations through malicious documents.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Excel 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未授权的本地代码执行，通过恶意文档对终端用户工作站构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows Deployment Services with a CVSS of 9.8 enables remote code execution without authentication, severely impacting enterprise deployment infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows Deployment Services 中的释放后使用漏洞（CVSS 评分为 9.8）可实现无需认证的远程代码执行，严重影响企业部署基础设施。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Installer can be leveraged by attackers to escalate privileges locally during routine software installation processes.
items.reason_zh: Windows Installer 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可被攻击者在常规软件安装过程中利用，以实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: High-severity heap overflow in Microsoft Edge enables remote code execution via malicious web content, posing a direct threat to end-user systems.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge 中的高危堆溢出漏洞可通过恶意网页内容实现远程代码执行，对终端用户系统构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Kernel-level buffer overflow allows local privilege escalation to SYSTEM level by exploiting memory corruption during file system operations.
items.reason_zh: 内核级缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过利用文件系统操作期间的内存损坏，实现向 SYSTEM 级别的本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Remote Desktop Client vulnerability permits unauthenticated network-based code execution, allowing attackers to compromise client machines without user interaction.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 漏洞允许未经认证的网络代码执行，使攻击者能够在无需用户交互的情况下入侵客户端计算机。

items.reason_en: Privilege escalation vulnerability in HP Easy Start for macOS could allow local attackers to gain elevated system permissions on widely deployed workstations.
items.reason_zh: macOS 版 HP Easy Start 中的权限提升漏洞可能允许本地攻击者在广泛部署的工作站上获取提升的系统权限。

items.reason_en: Stack buffer overflow in FFmpeg's MPEG-PS muxer triggers remote code execution when processing crafted media files containing excessive streams.
items.reason_zh: FFmpeg 的 MPEG-PS 复用器中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞在处理包含过多流的特制媒体文件时会触发远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in the libaom AV1 encoder's look-ahead processing mode allows arbitrary code execution via specially crafted video frames.
items.reason_zh: libaom AV1 编码器的预读处理模式中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过特制视频帧实现任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: The UI-TARS-desktop MCP server defaults to binding on all network interfaces without mandatory authentication, exposing local desktop AI services to remote exploitation.
items.reason_zh: UI-TARS-desktop MCP 服务器默认绑定所有网络接口且无强制身份验证，导致本地桌面 AI 服务暴露于远程利用风险之下。

items.reason_en: A buffer overflow in the WibuKey64.sys Windows driver allows out-of-bounds memory writes, which can trigger denial of service or potentially enable remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: WibuKey64.sys Windows 驱动程序中的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许越界内存写入，可能触发拒绝服务或潜在地启用远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: A kernel driver write-what-where primitive allows local attackers to escalate privileges to administrator level.
items.reason_zh: 内核驱动程序的任意地址写原语允许本地攻击者将权限提升至管理员级别。

items.reason_en: Modeline sandbox bypass in Vim enables arbitrary OS command execution when users open crafted text files.
items.reason_zh: Vim 中的 Modeline 沙箱绕过漏洞在用户打开特制文本文件时可启用任意操作系统命令执行。

items.reason_en: Symlink traversal in getfattr/setfattr utilities allows local privilege escalation by redirecting directory operations.
items.reason_zh: getfattr/setfattr 工具中的符号链接遍历漏洞允许通过重定向目录操作实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow during XCOFF object file linking can be triggered locally to achieve arbitrary code execution.
items.reason_zh: 在 XCOFF 目标文件链接期间发生的堆缓冲区溢出可被本地触发，从而实现任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in TeamViewer allows authenticated participants to write files to arbitrary locations via file transfer or clipboard, compromising host integrity.
items.reason_zh: TeamViewer 中的路径遍历漏洞允许已认证参与者通过文件传输或剪贴板将文件写入任意位置，从而破坏主机完整性。

items.reason_en: Path traversal flaw in Teams for Android allows unauthorized code execution by manipulating restricted directory paths, compromising mobile device isolation.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Teams 中的路径遍历缺陷允许通过操纵受限目录路径实现未授权代码执行，破坏移动设备隔离性。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated broken access control in the WooCommerce mobile app exposes sensitive user data and transaction details.
items.reason_zh: WooCommerce 移动应用中未认证的访问控制失效漏洞会暴露敏感用户数据和交易详情。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in TP-Link Tapo smart cameras allows local attackers to seize administrative session tokens, directly compromising device privacy and physical security controls.
items.reason_zh: TP-Link Tapo 智能摄像头中的身份验证绕过漏洞允许本地攻击者窃取管理会话令牌，直接损害设备隐私与物理安全控制。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the HTTP parser of Tapo cameras could destabilize firmware or potentially lead to code execution on resource-constrained edge devices.
items.reason_zh: Tapo 摄像头 HTTP 解析器中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可能导致固件不稳定，或在资源受限的边缘设备上引发代码执行。

items.reason_en: Exploitable out-of-bounds write in the Bluetooth Mesh SDK allows remote code execution on connected IoT devices, directly undermining mesh network integrity and device provisioning security.
items.reason_zh: Bluetooth Mesh SDK 中可利用的越界写入漏洞允许对已连接的物联网设备实施远程代码执行，直接破坏网状网络完整性与设备配置安全性。

items.reason_en: Authentication weakness in Xiiaozet LK100Wt allows attackers to bypass access controls and gain command execution, severely compromising IoT gateway security.
items.reason_zh: Xiiaozet LK100Wt 的身份验证缺陷允许攻击者绕过访问控制并获取命令执行权限，严重损害物联网网关安全性。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated invocation of administrative services on Xiiaozet LK100W devices permits remote attackers to enable restricted functionality and take full device control.
items.reason_zh: 在 Xiiaozet LK100W 设备上未认证调用管理服务允许远程攻击者启用受限功能并完全控制设备。

items.reason_en: Improper certificate validation in the ASE2000 controller firmware allows remote attackers to bypass TLS security, enabling man-in-the-middle attacks and interception of sensitive operational commands.
items.reason_zh: ASE2000 控制器固件中证书验证不当的漏洞允许远程攻击者绕过 TLS 安全机制，实施中间人攻击并拦截敏感操作指令。

items.reason_en: Chained firmware weaknesses in Unitree robotics enable unauthenticated root RCE over the network, severely impacting physical safety and operational integrity.
items.reason_zh: Unitree 机器人中的链式固件缺陷允许通过网络实现未认证的 Root 远程代码执行，严重影响物理安全与运行完整性。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in FreeRTOS allows unprivileged tasks to escalate to kernel-level privileges on MPU-enabled embedded systems, compromising core device security.
items.reason_zh: FreeRTOS 中输入验证不当的漏洞允许非特权任务在支持 MPU 的嵌入式系统中提权至内核级权限，破坏核心设备安全性。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded FTP credentials combined with unrestricted file uploads in DJI drones enable complete device compromise and unauthorized firmware modifications.
items.reason_zh: DJI 无人机中硬编码的 FTP 凭据与无限制的文件上传相结合，可导致设备彻底沦陷及未授权的固件修改。

items.reason_en: A stack-based buffer overflow in the TOTOLINK router's CGI handler allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code and fully compromise the device.
items.reason_zh: TOTOLINK 路由器 CGI 处理器中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未认证的远程攻击者执行任意代码并完全控制设备。

items.reason_en: Improper session validation in the ipTIME router bypasses authentication mechanisms, granting unauthorized remote access to network administrators and connected endpoints.
items.reason_zh: ipTIME 路由器中会话验证不当的漏洞会绕过身份验证机制，向未授权方授予对网络管理员及连接终端的远程访问权限。

items.reason_en: Firmware vulnerabilities in multiple Zbtlink router models allow remote attackers to gain unauthorized device control.
items.reason_zh: 多款 Zbtlink 路由器型号的固件漏洞允许远程攻击者获取未授权的设备控制权。

items.reason_en: DMA buffer flush failure in Qualcomm GENI UART drivers causes infinite corruption loops that can permanently brick embedded hardware.
items.reason_zh: Qualcomm GENI UART 驱动程序中 DMA 缓冲区刷新失败会导致无限损坏循环，可能使嵌入式硬件永久变砖。

items.reason_en: Stack buffer overflow in malicious NASL vulnerability test scripts can compromise security scanning appliances.
items.reason_zh: 恶意 NASL 漏洞测试脚本中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞可能危及安全扫描设备。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Wazuh's ip-customblock active response script permits root-level file manipulation, undermining the integrity of centralized XDR and SIEM deployments.
items.reason_zh: Wazuh 的 ip-customblock 主动响应脚本中存在的路径遍历漏洞允许进行根级别文件操作，破坏集中式 XDR 和 SIEM 部署的完整性。

items.reason_en: Inadequate masking of cluster secrets exposes sensitive manager configuration data to low-privileged users, weakening security orchestration across cloud and endpoint workloads.
items.reason_zh: 集群密钥的掩码处理不足会将敏感的管理配置数据暴露给低权限用户，削弱云和端点工作负载的安全编排能力。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Adobe Campaign Classic enables RCE without user interaction, directly jeopardizing cloud-hosted marketing infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Campaign Classic 中的授权错误漏洞无需用户交互即可实现远程代码执行，直接危及云托管营销基础设施。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in ACC allows attackers to execute arbitrary system commands remotely, leading to complete cloud environment compromise.
items.reason_zh: ACC 中的操作系统命令注入漏洞允许攻击者远程执行任意系统命令，导致整个云环境沦陷。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization flaw facilitates privilege escalation without user interaction, exposing sensitive campaign data and administrative controls.
items.reason_zh: 授权错误缺陷可在无需用户交互的情况下促成权限提升，暴露敏感的活动数据与管理控制权限。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated arbitrary code execution in Adobe Campaign Classic severely compromises cloud-based marketing infrastructure and requires immediate patching to prevent full system takeover.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Campaign Classic 中未认证的任意代码执行漏洞严重破坏了基于云的营销基础设施，需立即修补以防止系统被完全接管。

items.reason_en: Authorization failure in Ceph's Monitor subscription handler allows unauthorized users to access the configuration-key store, risking cluster-wide misconfiguration and data exposure.
items.reason_zh: Ceph 的 Monitor 订阅处理器中存在授权失败漏洞，允许未授权用户访问配置密钥存储，引发集群范围配置错误与数据泄露风险。

items.reason_en: Cryptographic weakness in Ceph's RGW STS token handler lacks message authentication, enabling token manipulation and unauthorized access to cloud storage resources.
items.reason_zh: Ceph 的 RGW STS 令牌处理器存在加密缺陷，缺乏消息认证机制，导致令牌可被篡改并未经授权访问云存储资源。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Entra ID allows unauthenticated remote code execution, potentially compromising the entire cloud identity and access management infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID 中对不信任数据进行反序列化可允许未认证的远程代码执行，可能破坏整个云身份与访问管理基础设施。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Azure SQL Database enables unauthorized privilege escalation and internal network pivoting, exposing critical database layers to lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Database 中的服务端请求伪造漏洞允许未授权权限提升和内网横向移动，使关键数据库层面临横向渗透威胁。

items.reason_en: Argument injection in Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra permits unauthenticated remote code execution, directly threatening cloud-native data processing pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra 中的参数注入漏洞允许未认证的远程代码执行，直接威胁云原生数据处理流水线。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Microsoft Teams allows unauthenticated privilege escalation, enabling attackers to manipulate collaboration workflows and access restricted tenant resources.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Teams 中缺失的授权机制允许未认证用户提升权限，使攻击者能够操纵协作工作流并访问受限的租户资源。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Windows Device Health Attestation permits remote code execution over a network. This undermines secure boot verification mechanisms crucial for zero-trust cloud endpoint compliance.
items.reason_zh: Windows Device Health Attestation 中的竞争条件允许通过网络进行远程代码执行。这破坏了零信任云终端合规性所依赖的关键安全启动验证机制。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Dynamics 365 allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network, threatening cloud ERP environments.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dynamics 365 中对不可信数据的反序列化允许已认证攻击者通过网络执行任意代码，威胁云 ERP 环境。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in Power BI enables network-based code execution, directly compromising cloud analytics and business intelligence platforms.
items.reason_zh: Power BI 中的输入验证不当支持基于网络的代码执行，直接危及云分析和商业智能平台。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Azure CycleCloud allows privilege escalation over the network, potentially disrupting container orchestration and workload management.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中缺失的授权机制允许通过网络提升权限，可能破坏容器编排和工作负载管理。

items.reason_en: Critical SSRF in Exchange Online enables unauthorized privilege escalation across the tenant, potentially leading to full mailbox and identity compromise.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Online 中的严重 SSRF 漏洞允许跨租户的未授权提权，可能导致邮箱和身份完全失陷。

items.reason_en: SSRF vulnerability in Azure Active Directory allows authorized users to escalate privileges and access sensitive internal metadata or services.
items.reason_zh: Azure Active Directory 中的 SSRF 漏洞允许授权用户提升权限并访问敏感的内部元数据或服务。

items.reason_en: SCIM provisioning flaw in Grafana Enterprise allows automated user lifecycle management to be exploited for complete account takeover and data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: Grafana Enterprise 中的 SCIM 配置缺陷允许利用自动化的用户生命周期管理机制实现完整的账户接管和数据外泄。

items.reason_en: Extremely high EPSS score indicates active exploitation; unauthenticated remote code execution in the ServiceNow AI platform poses severe enterprise operational risks.
items.reason_zh: 极高的 EPSS 评分表明存在活跃利用；ServiceNow AI 平台中的未认证远程代码执行对企业运营构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Flawed Athena-Neptune federated query connector design exposes Lambda environment variables, enabling unauthorized cloud credential theft and lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Athena-Neptune 联邦查询连接器设计缺陷导致 Lambda 环境变量暴露，使攻击者能够窃取云凭据并进行横向移动。

items.reason_en: Exposed session material in embedded Splunk reports allows unauthenticated attackers to hijack administrative sessions and exfiltrate sensitive log data.
items.reason_zh: 嵌入的 Splunk 报告中暴露的会话凭证允许未认证攻击者劫持管理员会话并外泄敏感日志数据。

items.reason_en: Forged HTTP headers bypass the Kuadrant AuthPolicy gateway, allowing any cluster pod to impersonate users and gain unauthorized access to internal services.
items.reason_zh: 伪造的 HTTP 头可绕过 Kuadrant AuthPolicy 网关，使集群中的任意 Pod 能够冒充用户并获取对内部服务的未授权访问。

items.reason_en: Spring Security's embedded LDAP server binds to all network interfaces with default administrative credentials, creating an immediate remote compromise vector.
items.reason_zh: Spring Security 的嵌入式 LDAP 服务器使用默认管理员凭据绑定所有网络接口，形成即时的远程入侵途径。

items.reason_en: SeaweedFS incorrectly accepts external OIDC JWTs in the Authorization header without enforcing IAM trust policies, enabling unauthorized role assumption.
items.reason_zh: SeaweedFS 在未强制执行 IAM 信任策略的情况下，错误地接受 Authorization 头中的外部 OIDC JWT，从而允许未授权的角色假设。

items.reason_en: Symlink validation bypass in KubeVirt's virt-handler allows namespace users to access host filesystems via VM console sockets.
items.reason_zh: KubeVirt 的 virt-handler 中存在符号链接验证绕过漏洞，允许命名空间用户通过虚拟机控制台套接字访问主机文件系统。

items.reason_en: EndpointSlice FQDN resolution to cloud metadata endpoints enables SSRF attacks and sensitive credential theft.
items.reason_zh: EndpointSlice 将 FQDN 解析至云元数据端点，可导致 SSRF 攻击及敏感凭据窃取。

items.reason_en: Email-based auto-linking without ownership verification in the AAP gateway facilitates remote account takeover.
items.reason_zh: AAP 网关中基于电子邮件的自动关联功能缺乏所有权验证，助长了远程账户接管。

items.reason_en: Stale page fault checks performed after MMU page allocation can lead to host memory corruption or virtual machine escapes.
items.reason_zh: 在 MMU 页面分配后执行的陈旧页错误检查可能导致主机内存损坏或虚拟机逃逸。

items.reason_en: Allows namespace-edit users to point Helm channels to malicious repositories, enabling supply chain attacks in Kubernetes environments.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞允许具有 namespace-edit 权限的用户将 Helm 通道指向恶意仓库，从而在 Kubernetes 环境中实施供应链攻击。

items.reason_en: Enables confused-deputy attacks where crafted Subscription CRs leverage privileged ServiceAccounts to deploy resources across namespaces.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞易受混淆副手攻击，攻击者可构造 Subscription CR 利用特权 ServiceAccount 跨命名空间部署资源。

items.reason_en: Authenticated developers can execute arbitrary commands in CI pipelines via the Claude agent integration, compromising build environments.
items.reason_zh: 已认证的开发者可通过 Claude agent 集成在 CI 流水线中执行任意命令，从而破坏构建环境。

items.reason_en: Flaw in Moby's SPDY parser allows memory exhaustion via unvalidated frame counts, destabilizing container networking.
items.reason_zh: Moby 的 SPDY 解析器存在缺陷，可通过未验证的帧计数导致内存耗尽，进而破坏容器网络稳定性。

items.reason_en: A race condition causing use-after-free in WatchGuard's LDAP authentication module enables remote unauthenticated code execution, critically endangering network perimeter defenses.
items.reason_zh: WatchGuard 的 LDAP 认证模块中存在引发释放后使用（Use-After-Free）的竞争条件，允许未认证的远程代码执行，严重危及网络边界防御。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the wgagent management process allows authenticated users to execute arbitrary code, risking full administrative takeover of firewall appliances.
items.reason_zh: wgagent 管理进程中的越界写入漏洞允许已认证用户执行任意代码，可能导致防火墙设备被完全接管。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in Streamvault appliances and Synergis Softwire installations could allow unauthorized modification of critical installation directories, disrupting network monitoring capabilities.
items.reason_zh: Streamvault 设备和 Synergis Softwire 安装程序中的访问控制不当可能导致未经授权的目录修改，破坏网络监控能力。

items.reason_en: The Telnyx MCP server exposes its HTTP transport on all interfaces without mandatory authentication, creating an immediate pathway for unauthorized remote access and control.
items.reason_zh: Telnyx MCP 服务器在所有接口上暴露其 HTTP 传输层且未强制要求认证，为未授权的远程访问和控制提供了即时途径。

items.reason_en: Marked as actively exploited in CISA KEV, this Linux kernel IPv6 fragmentation accounting flaw can lead to memory corruption or denial-of-service conditions in production network stacks.
items.reason_zh: 该 Linux 内核 IPv6 分片统计漏洞已被 CISA KEV 标记为正在被利用，可能导致生产网络协议栈出现内存损坏或拒绝服务状况。

items.reason_en: Local privilege escalation in the WatchGuard Mobile VPN client allows compromised endpoints to gain SYSTEM-level access, undermining network perimeter security controls.
items.reason_zh: WatchGuard Mobile VPN 客户端中的本地提权漏洞允许已失陷的终端获取 SYSTEM 级访问权限，削弱网络边界安全控制。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows DHCP Server enables remote code execution on adjacent networks. Compromising DHCP infrastructure disrupts network connectivity and facilitates lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许在相邻网络上进行远程代码执行。DHCP 基础设施失陷将破坏网络连接并促进横向移动。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows DNS allows remote privilege escalation over a network. Attacking DNS services can lead to complete breakdown of name resolution and network routing.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中的释放后使用漏洞允许通过网络进行远程提权。攻击 DNS 服务可能导致名称解析和网络路由完全中断。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows SMB Server permits remote code execution over a network. Given SMB's central role in file sharing, this poses severe ransomware and worm propagation risks.
items.reason_zh: Windows SMB Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许通过网络进行远程代码执行。鉴于 SMB 在文件共享中的核心作用，此漏洞会带来严重的勒索软件和蠕虫传播风险。

items.reason_en: Another SMB Server heap overflow with identical high-risk characteristics. Multiple instances indicate systemic issues requiring immediate patching across networked environments.
items.reason_zh: 另一处 SMB Server 堆溢出漏洞具有相同的高风险特征。多处实例表明存在系统性问题，需在联网环境中立即修补。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in RPC Runtime allows remote code execution over a network. RPC is foundational to Windows networking, making this a critical infrastructure threat.
items.reason_zh: RPC Runtime 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许通过网络进行远程代码执行。RPC 是 Windows 网络的基础架构，因此该漏洞构成关键基础设施威胁。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows iSCSI Target Service enables remote code execution with a CVSS of 9.8. This directly threatens storage area network (SAN) integrity and data availability.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI Target Service 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可导致远程代码执行，CVSS 评分为 9.8。该漏洞直接威胁存储区域网络（SAN）的完整性和数据可用性。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Windows DNS allows remote code execution without authentication, severely impacting network infrastructure and domain resolution services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出允许无需身份验证即可进行远程代码执行，严重影响网络基础设施和域名解析服务。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Microsoft QUIC enables remote code execution over the network, affecting modern secure transport protocols used across enterprise networks.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft QUIC 中的释放后使用（Use-after-free）漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，影响企业网络中广泛使用的现代安全传输协议。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows DNS permits remote code execution over the network, posing a significant risk to critical routing and name resolution functions.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中的释放后使用漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，对关键的路由和名称解析功能构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in rsyslog's RainerScript replace() function allows unauthenticated remote attackers to trigger crashes or execute code via malformed syslog messages.
items.reason_zh: rsyslog 的 RainerScript replace() 函数中存在堆缓冲区溢出，未认证的远程攻击者可通过构造恶意的 syslog 消息触发崩溃或执行代码。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Tor's rendezvous point handling enables man-in-the-middle impersonation of onion services, undermining network anonymity guarantees.
items.reason_zh: Tor 的中继点处理机制中存在竞争条件，可实现中间人冒充洋葱服务，破坏网络的匿名性保障。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write during consensus parsing could destabilize directory authorities and disrupt critical network routing functions.
items.reason_zh: 共识解析过程中的越界写入可能导致目录权威节点失稳，并破坏关键的网络路由功能。

items.reason_en: Pre-authentication command injection in the DrayTek VigorSwitch setget.cgi interface allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands without credentials.
items.reason_zh: DrayTek VigorSwitch 的 setget.cgi 接口中存在预认证命令注入漏洞，允许远程攻击者在无凭据的情况下执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Insufficient sanitization of the filename parameter in the tftp_upgrade function enables remote command injection, compromising switch management capabilities.
items.reason_zh: tftp_upgrade 函数中文件名参数清理不足，导致远程命令注入，从而破坏交换机管理功能。

items.reason_en: Fragment queue timer race condition in the Linux inet subsystem triggers reliable denial-of-service conditions.
items.reason_zh: Linux inet 子系统中的分片队列定时器竞争条件可触发稳定的拒绝服务（DoS）状况。

items.reason_en: Overly deep qdisc hierarchies exhaust kernel stacks during tree walks, causing network device crashes.
items.reason_zh: 过深的 qdisc 层次结构在树遍历期间会耗尽内核栈，导致网络设备崩溃。

items.reason_en: Socket use-after-free triggered by pending timers in the net/x25 subsystem leads to reliable exploitation or DoS.
items.reason_zh: net/x25 子系统中待处理定时器触发的套接字释放后使用漏洞可导致可靠利用或拒绝服务（DoS）。

items.reason_en: Improper handling of non-Internet DNS message classes causes parser crashes and service disruption in BIND servers.
items.reason_zh: 对非 Internet DNS 消息类的处理不当会导致 BIND 服务器解析器崩溃及服务中断。

items.reason_en: Unescaped username substitution in Samba password scripts enables remote command injection on domain controllers.
items.reason_zh: Samba 密码脚本中用户名替换未进行转义，可在域控制器上实现远程命令注入。

items.reason_en: Malformed TKEY/GSS-API packets cause excessive memory consumption, disrupting DNS services in Active Directory deployments.
items.reason_zh: 格式错误的 TKEY/GSS-API 数据包会导致内存过度消耗，破坏 Active Directory 部署中的 DNS 服务。

items.reason_en: Critical CRLF injection flaw enables complete authentication bypass in UniFi OS, granting unauthorized network access.
items.reason_zh: UniFi OS 中存在关键的 CRLF 注入缺陷，可导致完整的身份验证绕过，从而授予未经授权的访问权限。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in UniFi OS Server allows command injection by high-privilege users, compromising host systems.
items.reason_zh: UniFi OS Server 中输入验证不当，允许高权限用户进行命令注入，从而危及主机系统。

items.reason_en: Improper tuple publishing order in Linux netfilter flow tables allows premature garbage collection, breaking packet forwarding.
items.reason_zh: Linux netfilter 流表中元组发布顺序不当会导致过早垃圾回收，破坏数据包转发。

items.reason_en: Missing headroom/tailroom inheritance in IPvLAN drivers causes buffer overflows when underlying physical devices require extra space.
items.reason_zh: IPvLAN 驱动程序中缺失 headroom/tailroom 继承机制，当底层物理设备需要额外空间时会引发缓冲区溢出。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the Bendix EC80 Brake ECU may allow attackers to crash the unit or inject malicious CAN bus traffic, directly threatening automotive safety systems.
items.reason_zh: Bendix EC80 Brake ECU 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出可能允许攻击者使设备崩溃或注入恶意 CAN 总线流量，直接威胁汽车安全系统。

items.reason_en: Siemens Element maps-ng fails to neutralize user-controllable input in rendering parameters, potentially allowing XSS attacks that manipulate critical infrastructure visualization dashboards.
items.reason_zh: Siemens Element maps-ng 未能对渲染参数中用户可控的输入进行净化，可能导致 XSS 攻击，进而操纵关键基础设施可视化仪表板。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in Mitsubishi Electric CC-Link IE TSN modules could allow manipulation of quantity parameters, risking operational disruption.
items.reason_zh: 三菱电机 CC-Link IE TSN 模块中输入验证不当可能导致数量参数被篡改，存在运行中断风险。

items.reason_en: Stored Cross-Site Scripting in Adobe Commerce allows low-privileged attackers to inject malicious scripts into storefront forms, potentially hijacking user sessions or disrupting e-commerce operations.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Commerce 中存在的存储型跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞允许低权限攻击者将恶意脚本注入商店表单，可能劫持用户会话或破坏电子商务运营。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization flaws enable security feature bypasses, granting unauthorized read and limited write access that compromises merchant data and application availability.
items.reason_zh: 授权逻辑缺陷导致安全功能被绕过，授予未经授权的读取和受限写入权限，从而危及商户数据和应用程序可用性。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in ColdFusion allows arbitrary code execution without user interaction and is already confirmed in CISA KEV, indicating active exploitation.
items.reason_zh: ColdFusion 中的路径遍历漏洞允许无需用户交互即可执行任意代码，且已确认收录于 CISA KEV 中，表明正遭活跃利用。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Adobe Commerce enables privilege escalation without user interaction, threatening e-commerce platforms and customer data integrity.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Commerce 中的不正确授权漏洞允许无需用户交互即可实现权限提升，威胁电子商务平台及客户数据完整性。

items.reason_en: Eval injection in ColdFusion permits arbitrary code execution via web requests, severely impacting application server security and backend operations.
items.reason_zh: ColdFusion 中的 Eval 注入漏洞允许通过 Web 请求执行任意代码，严重影响应用服务器安全和后端操作。

items.reason_en: Stored XSS in Adobe Experience Manager Forms allows attackers to inject malicious scripts into web pages, compromising session integrity and user data.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Experience Manager Forms 中的存储型跨站脚本漏洞允许攻击者将恶意脚本注入网页，从而破坏会话完整性并危及用户数据。

items.reason_en: High-severity DOM-based cross-site scripting in Adobe Connect enables session hijacking and privilege escalation for meeting participants and administrators without requiring external payloads.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Connect 中存在的高危 DOM 型跨站脚本漏洞使会议参与者和管理员能够在无需外部载荷的情况下实现会话劫持与权限提升。

items.reason_en: Critical unauthenticated remote code execution in Oracle Helidon's Imperative Web Server allows network attackers to fully compromise underlying systems without credentials.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Helidon 的 Imperative Web Server 中存在严重的未授权远程代码执行漏洞，允许网络攻击者在无需凭据的情况下完全控制底层系统。

items.reason_en: Stored Cross-Site Scripting in Adobe Commerce enables high-privileged attackers to inject malicious scripts into form fields, facilitating session hijacking and data theft.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Commerce 中的存储型跨站脚本漏洞允许高权限攻击者将恶意脚本注入表单字段，进而促成会话劫持与数据窃取。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in the ServiceNow AI platform enables unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary database queries, leading to full data exfiltration and administrative takeover.
items.reason_zh: ServiceNow AI 平台中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许未授权攻击者执行任意数据库查询，从而导致全面的数据泄露与管理权限接管。

items.reason_en: Code injection in the ServiceNow AI platform allows unauthenticated remote code execution, severely impacting enterprise workflow automation and instance integrity.
items.reason_zh: ServiceNow AI 平台中的代码注入漏洞可导致未授权的远程代码执行，严重破坏企业工作流自动化及实例完整性。

items.reason_en: Weak authorization in FastGPT's WeChat share-channel endpoints allows unauthenticated access to knowledge bases, exposing sensitive AI training data and proprietary information.
items.reason_zh: FastGPT 的微信分享渠道端点存在授权缺陷，允许未授权访问知识库，从而暴露敏感的 AI 训练数据与企业专有信息。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Dolibarr's CSV/XLSX import wizard bypasses generic filters, enabling attackers to manipulate backend database records and escalate privileges within the ERP system.
items.reason_zh: Dolibarr 的 CSV/XLSX 导入向导中存在 SQL 注入漏洞，可绕过常规过滤机制，使攻击者能够篡改后端数据库记录并在 ERP 系统中实现权限提升。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables remote code execution over a network. This flaw directly impacts web application servers hosting critical business content.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中存在对不可信数据进行反序列化的漏洞，可导致通过网络执行远程代码执行。该缺陷直接影响托管关键业务内容的 Web 应用服务器。

items.reason_en: Another SharePoint deserialization flaw allows remote code execution with an elevated EPSS score (0.0191). It highlights persistent serialization risks in legacy Microsoft web platforms.
items.reason_zh: 另一处 SharePoint 反序列化漏洞可导致远程代码执行，其 EPSS 评分较高（0.0191）。该漏洞凸显了传统 Microsoft Web 平台中持续存在的反序列化安全风险。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass via capture-replay in Exchange Server allows remote privilege escalation. This severely compromises email infrastructure security and confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中存在通过抓包重放实现的认证绕过漏洞，可导致远程权限提升。该漏洞严重威胁电子邮件基础设施的安全性与机密性。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint enables network-based spoofing attacks. Attackers can leverage this to steal credentials or redirect users to malicious sites.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞可被用于实施基于网络的欺骗攻击。攻击者可借此窃取用户凭据或将其重定向至恶意站点。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Entra Connect Sync allows local privilege escalation by manipulating database queries. This threatens hybrid identity synchronization between on-premises and cloud directories.
items.reason_zh: Entra Connect Sync 中的 SQL 注入漏洞可通过篡改数据库查询实现本地权限提升，严重威胁本地环境与云目录间的混合身份同步安全。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows remote code execution over the network, targeting enterprise web portals and collaboration sites.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中存在对不可信数据进行反序列化的漏洞，可导致通过网络执行远程代码执行，主要影响企业 Web 门户与协作站点。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Exchange Server enables remote code execution, directly impacting organizational email infrastructure and web services.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，直接破坏组织内部的电子邮件基础设施与 Web 服务。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Visual Studio Code allows unauthorized remote code execution, threatening developer environments and automated build pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的操作系统命令注入漏洞可导致未授权的远程代码执行，严重威胁开发者工作环境及自动化构建流水线。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables remote code execution, allowing attackers to fully compromise the underlying server infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中存在对不可信数据进行反序列化的漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，使攻击者能够完全控制底层服务器基础设施。

items.reason_en: Insecure default configuration in Trilium allows stored XSS via unsanitized note titles, facilitating credential theft or session hijacking in collaborative workflows.
items.reason_zh: Trilium 的不安全默认配置允许通过未过滤的笔记标题触发存储型跨站脚本漏洞，从而在协作工作流中促成凭据窃取或会话劫持。

items.reason_en: Default misconfiguration in mcp-router exposes the aggregator to all network interfaces without mandatory authentication, enabling immediate unauthorized access.
items.reason_zh: mcp-router 的默认配置错误导致聚合器在未强制要求身份验证的情况下向所有网络接口开放，致使攻击者可立即进行未授权访问。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated request variable overwrite in the Tutor LMS WordPress plugin enables arbitrary PHP function execution, leading to complete site takeover.
items.reason_zh: Tutor LMS WordPress 插件中存在未授权请求变量覆盖漏洞，可导致任意 PHP 函数执行，进而引发网站被完全接管。

items.reason_en: Chained SQL expressions and plugin flaws in Grafana result in remote code execution, potentially compromising entire monitoring infrastructures and backend data stores.
items.reason_zh: Grafana 中链式 SQL 表达式与插件缺陷相结合可导致远程代码执行，潜在威胁整个监控基础设施及后端数据存储的安全。

items.reason_en: Direct SQL injection in multiple video API endpoints allows attackers to manipulate database structures and extract sensitive information without authentication.
items.reason_zh: 多个视频 API 端点中存在直接 SQL 注入漏洞，使攻击者能够在无需身份验证的情况下篡改数据库结构并窃取敏感信息。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated privilege escalation in the WordPress Total Donations plugin allows attackers to elevate their account to administrator level and take full control of the site.
items.reason_zh: WordPress Total Donations 插件中存在未授权权限提升漏洞，使攻击者能够将自身账户提升至管理员级别，从而完全控制网站。

items.reason_en: Authorization and input validation flaws in the Avada theme and Fusion Builder chain together to enable arbitrary file writes, facilitating complete website compromise.
items.reason_zh: Avada 主题与 Fusion Builder 中的授权缺陷及输入验证漏洞相互结合，可导致任意文件写入，进而促成网站被完全攻陷。

items.reason_en: Unrestricted file upload functionality in the UltimateAI WordPress plugin allows attackers to deploy malicious PHP webshells directly onto the server.
items.reason_zh: UltimateAI WordPress 插件中存在无限制的文件上传功能，使攻击者能够将恶意 PHP Webshell 直接上传至服务器。

items.reason_en: Insufficient validation of dynamic client registration metadata in Spring Security OAuth2 enables authentication bypass.
items.reason_zh: Spring Security OAuth2 中对动态客户端注册元数据的验证不足可导致认证绕过漏洞。

items.reason_en: Unrestricted editor file uploads in Fluent Boards Pro allow remote code execution on vulnerable WordPress installations.
items.reason_zh: Fluent Boards Pro 中的无限制编辑器文件上传功能可在存在漏洞的 WordPress 环境中导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Default configuration bypasses HTML sanitization via xmp elements, enabling stored cross-site scripting attacks.
items.reason_zh: 默认配置下通过 xmp 标签可绕过 HTML 过滤机制，从而触发存储型跨站脚本攻击。

items.reason_en: Lenient HTTP/2 :path pseudo-header validation in gRPC-Go results in authorization bypasses for protected endpoints.
items.reason_zh: gRPC-Go 中对 HTTP/2 :path 伪头的校验过于宽松，可导致受保护端点出现授权绕过漏洞。

items.reason_en: Inadequate operator-token validation allows backslash-escaping bypasses leading to arbitrary code injection.
items.reason_zh: 操作符令牌验证机制不完善，允许通过反斜杠转义进行绕过，进而导致任意代码注入。

items.reason_en: Pre-parsed AST compilation directly emits values into generated JavaScript, facilitating code injection attacks.
items.reason_zh: 预解析AST编译会将值直接输出到生成的JavaScript代码中，从而便于代码注入攻击。

items.reason_en: Inefficient GraphQL rate-limiting algorithms pin APISIX gateway workers at 100% CPU, causing service disruption.
items.reason_zh: 低效的GraphQL限流算法会使APISIX网关工作进程的CPU占用率持续达到100%，从而导致服务中断。

items.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling on serverless-plugin routes splits responses between legitimate clients and attackers.
items.reason_zh: serverless插件路由上的HTTP请求/响应走私漏洞会导致响应被拆分发送给合法客户端与攻击者。

items.reason_en: Chunk extension termination flaws in Jetty enable HTTP/1.1 request smuggling similar to funky-chunks techniques.
items.reason_zh: Jetty中的分块扩展终止缺陷可触发类似funky-chunks技术的HTTP/1.1请求走私。

items.reason_en: Insecure filename sanitization in Rollup permits arbitrary file writes via path traversal during build processes.
items.reason_zh: Rollup中不安全的文件名过滤机制会在构建过程中通过路径遍历允许任意文件写入。

items.reason_en: Aggressive Brotli decompression of entire responses instead of requested chunks causes severe memory exhaustion.
items.reason_zh: 对完整响应而非请求分块进行激进的Brotli解压缩会导致严重的内存耗尽。

items.reason_en: Streaming API fails to properly handle Content-Encoding headers, leading to decompression-based denial-of-service.
items.reason_zh: 流式API未能正确处理Content-Encoding头部，从而导致基于解压缩的拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Acceptance of zip bombs in compressed requests exhausts aiohttp server memory, disrupting async web services.
items.reason_zh: 接受压缩请求中的zip炸弹会耗尽aiohttp服务器内存，进而破坏异步Web服务。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in a WordPress plugin enables remote code execution on vulnerable installations.
items.reason_zh: WordPress插件中存在未认证的PHP对象注入漏洞，可在易受攻击的实例上实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited deserialization flaw in ajaxpro.2 allows remote code execution on affected .NET web applications.
items.reason_zh: ajaxpro.2中遭活跃利用的反序列化缺陷可使受影响的.NET Web应用程序发生远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: TOCTOU vulnerability in Spring Cloud Config SVN cloning allows directory traversal attacks during configuration synchronization.
items.reason_zh: Spring Cloud Config在SVN克隆操作中存在TOCTOU漏洞，可在配置同步期间引发目录遍历攻击。

items.reason_en: Distributed HTTP session store flaw in Spring Security WebAuthn support enables user verification bypass, weakening MFA.
items.reason_zh: Spring Security的WebAuthn支持中分布式HTTP会话存储存在缺陷，可导致用户验证绕过，从而削弱多因素认证(MFA)的安全性。

items.reason_en: Critical code injection vulnerability in Adobe ColdFusion allows low-privileged attackers to execute arbitrary system commands, severely compromising application server infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Adobe ColdFusion中存在严重的代码注入漏洞，允许低权限攻击者执行任意系统命令，严重危及应用服务器基础设施。

items.reason_en: Path traversal flaw in ColdFusion enables unrestricted reading of sensitive server files, exposing internal configurations, credentials, and proprietary application logic.
items.reason_zh: ColdFusion中的路径遍历缺陷允许无限制读取敏感服务器文件，从而暴露内部配置、凭据及专有应用逻辑。

items.reason_en: Connection-option injection in the MongoDB C# Driver allows attackers to manipulate database connections via untrusted URLs, risking unauthorized data access or manipulation.
items.reason_zh: MongoDB C# Driver中的连接选项注入漏洞允许攻击者通过不受信任的URL操纵数据库连接，带来未经授权的数据访问或篡改风险。

items.reason_en: A high EPSS score indicates significant real-world exploitation potential, while the path traversal flaw in ColdFusion allows attackers to read sensitive server files and escalate privileges.
items.reason_zh: 较高的EPSS评分表明该漏洞具有显著的实际利用潜力，而ColdFusion中的路径遍历缺陷允许攻击者读取敏感服务器文件并提升权限。

items.reason_en: Inadequate sanitization of namespace identifiers in the MongoDB PHP client can redirect database operations to unintended targets, leading to data leakage or corruption.
items.reason_zh: MongoDB PHP客户端对命名空间标识符的过滤不足，可能导致数据库操作被重定向至非预期目标，进而引发数据泄露或损坏。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization middleware in go-wind-cms returns a no-op engine, effectively bypassing access controls and exposing administrative functions to any authenticated user.
items.reason_zh: go-wind-cms中缺失的授权中间件会返回空操作引擎，从而有效绕过访问控制，并向任何已认证用户暴露管理功能。

items.reason_en: Easily exploitable LDAP server vulnerability in Oracle Internet Directory allows low-privileged network attackers to fully compromise directory services and steal credentials.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Internet Directory中易于利用的LDAP服务器漏洞允许低权限网络攻击者完全接管目录服务并窃取凭据。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Redis' TLS processing function enables unauthenticated remote code execution, directly threatening high-performance caching and message queue deployments.
items.reason_zh: Redis的TLS处理函数中存在释放后使用(UAF)漏洞，可实现未认证的远程代码执行，直接威胁高性能缓存与消息队列部署。

items.reason_en: Pre-signed URL acceptance bypass in ownCloud allows unauthenticated file access, modification, or deletion when victim usernames are known, breaking core data protection mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: ownCloud中预签名URL验证绕过漏洞在已知受害者用户名时，允许未认证访问、修改或删除文件，破坏了核心数据保护机制。

items.reason_en: Relative path traversal in .NET Framework allows local privilege escalation. Exploiting this can compromise applications relying on insecure file system operations within the runtime.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework中存在相对路径遍历漏洞，可导致本地权限提升。利用该漏洞可破坏依赖运行时中不安全文件系统操作的应用程序。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in .NET enables local privilege escalation through malformed numeric inputs. This affects a wide range of enterprise applications built on the framework.
items.reason_zh: .NET中的整数溢出漏洞可通过畸形数字输入实现本地权限提升，影响基于该框架构建的众多企业应用程序。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in .NET permits local code execution by corrupting memory structures. It underscores the need for rigorous input validation in managed code deployments.
items.reason_zh: .NET中的越界写入漏洞可通过破坏内存结构实现本地代码执行，凸显了在托管代码部署中进行严格输入验证的必要性。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Windows GDI+ allows remote code execution over a network. As a core graphics processing component, it impacts numerous rendering and document viewing services.
items.reason_zh: Windows GDI+中的整数溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行。作为核心图形处理组件，其影响波及众多渲染与文档查看服务。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Active Directory Certificate Services allows remote code execution over the network, compromising critical PKI and certificate issuance infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Certificate Services中的释放后使用(UAF)漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，从而破坏关键的PKI与证书颁发基础设施。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Local Security Authority Server enables remote code execution, risking core Windows authentication and credential validation mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Local Security Authority Server中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现远程代码执行，危及Windows核心身份验证与凭据验证机制。

items.reason_en: Unchecked input for loop conditions in .NET causes denial of service over the network, disrupting middleware applications and backend services relying on the framework.
items.reason_zh: .NET中循环条件的输入未经验证会导致网络拒绝服务，破坏依赖该框架的中间件应用与后端服务。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Azure SQL Database allows authenticated attackers to elevate privileges and extract or modify sensitive database contents directly.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Database中的SQL注入漏洞允许已认证攻击者提升权限，并直接提取或修改敏感数据库内容。

items.reason_en: Spring Integration's deserialization protection fails when configured as a managed bean, leaving applications vulnerable to remote code execution via crafted payloads.
items.reason_zh: 当Spring Integration配置为托管Bean时，其反序列化保护机制会失效，使应用程序易受通过构造载荷发起的远程代码执行攻击。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in GeoTools' PostGIS datastore implementation allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary database queries against geospatial datasets.
items.reason_zh: GeoTools的PostGIS数据存储实现中存在SQL注入漏洞，允许未认证的攻击者对地理空间数据集执行任意数据库查询。

items.reason_en: WebSocket message compression flaw in Red Hat Undertow causes exponential memory allocation, enabling reliable denial-of-service attacks against enterprise middleware.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Undertow中的WebSocket消息压缩缺陷会导致指数级内存分配，从而能够对企业中间件实施稳定的拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Feast improperly deserializes user-defined functions using the 'dill' library, enabling unauthenticated remote code execution on feature storage servers.
items.reason_zh: Feast使用'dill'库对用户定义函数进行不正确的反序列化，导致在特征存储服务器上发生未认证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: The AdminerFileUpload plugin permits unrestricted PHP file uploads via a permissive extension allowlist, allowing authenticated users to achieve remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: AdminerFileUpload插件通过宽松的扩展白名单允许不受限制的PHP文件上传，使已认证用户能够实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Incorrectly ignored certificate name constraints allow remote attackers to bypass critical TLS validation checks.
items.reason_zh: 证书名称约束被错误忽略，导致远程攻击者能够绕过关键的TLS验证检查。

items.reason_en: DTLS handshake fragment reassembly lacks message length validation, causing heap buffer overflows and potential RCE.
items.reason_zh: DTLS握手分片重组缺乏消息长度验证，导致堆缓冲区溢出及潜在的远程代码执行(RCE)。

items.reason_en: Malformed DTLS fragments with zero length trigger integer underflows, resulting in out-of-bounds information disclosure.
items.reason_zh: 长度为零的畸形DTLS分片会触发整数下溢，导致越界信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Flawed DTLS packet reordering comparator fails on duplicate sequence numbers, disrupting secure transport connections.
items.reason_zh: 存在缺陷的DTLS数据包重排序比较器在处理重复序列号时会失效，从而破坏安全传输连接。

items.reason_en: RSA-PSK authentication incorrectly matches NUL characters in usernames, enabling remote authentication bypass.
items.reason_zh: RSA-PSK认证错误地匹配用户名中的NUL字符，导致远程身份验证绕过。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in Camel Infinispan's ProtoStream repository allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code.
items.reason_zh: Camel Infinispan的ProtoStream存储库中存在不安全的反序列化漏洞，允许远程攻击者执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Implementation of a broken or risky cryptographic algorithm in Bouncy Castle compromises data confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: Bouncy Castle中实现了损坏或有风险的加密算法，导致数据机密性受损。

items.reason_en: Unthrottled resource allocation in AEAD encryption modules enables denial-of-service attacks against middleware.
items.reason_zh: AEAD加密模块中无限制的资源分配可导致针对中间件的拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Azure AD client secrets exposed in logs due to improper Secret type classification in Prometheus configurations.
items.reason_zh: 由于Prometheus配置中Secret类型分类不当，导致Azure AD客户端密钥在日志中泄露。

items.reason_en: Missing decoded length validation for snappy-compressed requests allows unauthenticated denial-of-service attacks.
items.reason_zh: 针对snappy压缩请求缺少解码长度验证，允许未认证的攻击者实施拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Attacker-controlled 64-bit values narrowed to platform ints cause integer overflows and memory corruption in Avro decoders.
items.reason_zh: 攻击者控制的64位值被截断为平台整型时，会在Avro解码器中引发整数溢出和内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Array and map decoders ignore reader error states during loop iterations, leading to memory corruption and crashes.
items.reason_zh: 数组和映射解码器在循环迭代期间忽略读取器的错误状态，导致内存损坏和程序崩溃。

items.reason_en: Improper JWE decryption handling causes application panics, resulting in reliable denial-of-service conditions.
items.reason_zh: 不当的JWE解密处理会导致应用程序恐慌，从而引发稳定复现的拒绝服务状况。

items.reason_en: Malformed RELATIVE-OID structures with excessive continuation octets trigger memory exhaustion in pyasn1 parsers.
items.reason_zh: 包含过多延续字节的畸形RELATIVE-OID结构会在pyasn1解析器中触发内存耗尽。

items.reason_en: Untrusted length values in rsync receiver xattr processing cause use-after-free vulnerabilities during synchronization.
items.reason_zh: rsync接收端xattr处理中使用不受信任的长度值，会在同步过程中导致释放后使用(use-after-free)漏洞。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated SQL injection in a WordPress statistics plugin allows attackers to extract sensitive database contents.
items.reason_zh: WordPress统计插件中存在未认证的SQL注入漏洞，允许攻击者提取敏感的数据库内容。

items.reason_en: Unsafe decoding in Ceph client allows malicious OSDs to trigger slab-out-of-bounds reads, compromising distributed storage integrity.
items.reason_zh: Ceph客户端中存在不安全的解码逻辑，允许恶意OSD触发slab越界读取，破坏分布式存储的完整性。

items.reason_en: Cache-based replay attack in Spring Security DPoP JWT decoder allows token reuse, undermining proof-of-possession security.
items.reason_zh: Spring Security DPoP JWT解码器中存在基于缓存的重放攻击，允许令牌重用，削弱了持有证明(Proof-of-Possession)安全性。

items.reason_en: Use of a hard-coded cryptographic key bypasses security controls without user interaction, undermining data confidentiality across affected Adobe services.
items.reason_zh: 使用硬编码的加密密钥可在无需用户交互的情况下绕过安全控制，损害受影响Adobe服务的整体数据机密性。

items.reason_en: NULL pointer dereference in CAI Content Credentials triggers application crashes, enabling denial-of-service attacks against digital content verification systems.
items.reason_zh: CAI Content Credentials中的空指针解引用会触发应用程序崩溃，从而导致针对数字内容验证系统的拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Officially listed in CISA KEV, this prototype pollution vulnerability in Acrobat Reader is actively exploited in the wild to achieve arbitrary code execution when users open malicious documents.
items.reason_zh: 该Acrobat Reader原型链污染漏洞已被CISA KEV官方收录，已在实际环境中被积极利用，当用户打开恶意文档时可实现任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization on PayRange API management endpoints publicly exposes verbose details of every connected device, enabling reconnaissance and potential device takeover.
items.reason_zh: PayRange API管理端点缺少授权机制，公开暴露了所有已连接设备的详细详情，使攻击者能够进行侦察并潜在接管设备。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Lektor's built-in development server allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files accessible to the process, disclosing sensitive project data.
items.reason_zh: Lektor内置开发服务器中存在路径遍历漏洞，允许远程攻击者读取进程可访问的任意文件，从而泄露敏感的项目数据。

items.reason_en: Arbitrary code execution in SpeechBrain via unsafe YAML parsing during checkpoint enumeration exposes AI/ML development pipelines to malicious model artifacts.
items.reason_zh: 通过检查点枚举期间不安全的YAML解析，SpeechBrain中存在任意代码执行漏洞，使AI/ML开发流水线面临恶意模型制品的风险。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in NLTK model-artifact APIs bypasses sandbox enforcement, allowing attackers to read or write arbitrary files outside designated directories during NLP operations.
items.reason_zh: NLTK模型制品API中的路径遍历漏洞绕过了沙箱强制策略，允许攻击者在NLP操作期间读写指定目录外的任意文件。

items.reason_en: Improper authorization in Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE platform allows attackers to gain unauthorized access to user accounts, threatening proprietary CAD and PLM data.
items.reason_zh: Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE平台中存在授权不当问题，允许攻击者未经授权访问用户账户，威胁专有CAD和PLM数据的安全。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited in the wild per CISA KEV, this WinSock use-after-free vulnerability allows local privilege escalation and requires immediate remediation.
items.reason_zh: 根据CISA KEV记录，该WinSock释放后使用漏洞已在野外被积极利用，可导致本地权限提升，需立即修复。

items.reason_en: Known as 'ShieldBreak', this elevation of privilege flaw in Microsoft Defender undermines endpoint protection capabilities and bypasses security engine safeguards.
items.reason_zh: 被称为“ShieldBreak”的此Microsoft Defender提权缺陷削弱了端点保护能力，并绕过了安全引擎防护机制。

items.reason_en: Command injection in PowerShell allows authorized attackers to execute local code, potentially bypassing administrative controls and policy restrictions.
items.reason_zh: PowerShell中的命令注入漏洞允许授权攻击者执行本地代码，可能绕过管理控制和策略限制。

items.reason_en: Sandbox escape in ToolUniverse allows arbitrary Python execution on an unauthenticated server, granting full system control through flawed input filtering.
items.reason_zh: ToolUniverse中的沙箱逃逸漏洞允许在未认证服务器上任意执行Python代码，通过有缺陷的输入过滤机制获取完整系统控制权。

items.reason_en: Denylist-based plugin verification in jahlives allows unsigned malicious plugins to bypass signature checks and execute arbitrary code at import time.
items.reason_zh: jahlives中基于黑名单的插件验证机制允许未签名的恶意插件绕过签名检查，并在导入时执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Unvalidated JVM options passed through NLTK wrapper classes allow attackers to inject malicious agents and achieve arbitrary code execution in NLP environments.
items.reason_zh: 经NLTK包装类传递的未验证JVM选项允许攻击者注入恶意代理，从而在自然语言处理环境中实现任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Insecure pickle deserialization in NLTK bypasses allowlist restrictions, enabling remote code execution within machine learning and natural language processing pipelines.
items.reason_zh: NLTK中不安全的pickle反序列化漏洞可绕过白名单限制，使攻击者能够在机器学习和自然语言处理流水线中实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication on PraisonAI agent invocation endpoints allows unauthenticated network callers to abuse configured AI models, risking data leakage and resource exhaustion.
items.reason_zh: PraisonAI智能体调用端点缺少身份验证，允许未认证的网络调用者滥用已配置的AI模型，存在数据泄露和资源耗尽风险。

items.reason_en: The openssl_encrypt library fails to re-validate fingerprints when loading identities, allowing attackers to silently substitute public keys and facilitate man-in-the-middle attacks.
items.reason_zh: openssl_encrypt库在加载身份标识时未能重新验证指纹，允许攻击者静默替换公钥并实施中间人攻击。

items.reason_en: The Maquina App Ruby sandbox escapes its pattern denylist by leveraging unreplaced pseudo-terminal spawn methods, breaking application isolation boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Maquina App的Ruby沙箱通过利用未替换的伪终端生成方法绕过模式黑名单，破坏了应用程序隔离边界。

items.reason_en: Predictable temporary file creation under CM-Stick enables local privilege escalation via NTFS junction manipulation.
items.reason_zh: CM-Stick下可预测的临时文件创建漏洞可通过操纵NTFS连接点实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Missing network-origin restrictions on CodeMeter server commands allow remote execution of administrative functions.
items.reason_zh: CodeMeter服务器命令缺少网络来源限制，允许远程执行管理功能。

items.reason_en: Unsanitized logger input permits printf-style format string injection, crashing the service and leaking process memory.
items.reason_zh: 未经清理的日志记录器输入允许printf风格格式字符串注入，导致服务崩溃并泄露进程内存。

items.reason_en: Missing bounds checking on opcode data lengths causes out-of-bounds reads and segmentation faults in runtime handlers.
items.reason_zh: 操作码数据长度缺少边界检查会导致运行时处理器发生越界读取和段错误。

items.reason_en: Cryptographically weak session identifiers enable brute-force attacks to hijack license management sessions.
items.reason_zh: 密码学强度不足的会话标识符使得攻击者能够通过暴力破解劫持许可证管理会话。

items.reason_en: Mutually exclusive MPTCP suboptions combined improperly cause protocol state corruption and kernel crashes.
items.reason_zh: 互斥的MPTCP子选项组合不当会导致协议状态损坏及内核崩溃。

items.reason_en: Missing bounds check in libceph watcher decoding accepts struct_len=0, triggering out-of-bounds memory reads.
items.reason_zh: libceph监视器解码过程中缺少边界检查，接受struct_len=0参数，触发越界内存读取。

items.reason_en: Incorrect first IDAW boundary calculation miscalculates buffer sizes, risking memory corruption in s390 virtualization.
items.reason_zh: 首个IDAW边界计算错误导致缓冲区大小计算偏差，在s390虚拟化环境中存在内存损坏风险。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in abandoned read page unlocking can be leveraged for arbitrary memory writes in netfs subsystems.
items.reason_zh: 废弃读页解锁过程中的释放后使用漏洞可在netfs子系统中被用于实现任意内存写入。

items.reason_en: Assumption of block-aligned read positions leads to out-of-bounds reads on misaligned offsets in iomap layer.
items.reason_zh: 对块对齐读取位置的假设导致iomap层在处理非对齐偏移量时发生越界读取。

items.reason_en: Improper CPU cache isolation on Zen 2 allows cross-privilege instruction corruption, potentially escalating privileges.
items.reason_zh: Zen 2架构上CPU缓存隔离不当允许跨特权级指令篡改，可能导致权限提升。

items.reason_en: Unbounded next_id allocation via checkpoint/restore sysctl can exhaust system ID ranges and cause resource leaks.
items.reason_zh: 通过checkpoint/restore sysctl进行无限制的next_id分配可能耗尽系统ID范围并引发资源泄漏。

items.reason_en: Independent multi-value baggage header parsing amplifies CPU usage and allocations, causing denial-of-service.
items.reason_zh: 独立解析多值baggage头部会放大CPU使用率和内存分配，导致拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Failure to canonicalize Unicode IDN hostnames enables silent phishing and domain spoofing attacks.
items.reason_zh: 未能规范化Unicode IDN主机名使得隐蔽钓鱼和域名伪造攻击成为可能。

items.reason_en: Re-emitting decoded percent-encoded authority delimiters as raw characters breaks URL parsing boundaries.
items.reason_zh: 将解码后的百分号编码权限分隔符作为原始字符重新输出会破坏URL解析边界。

items.reason_en: Decompression mismatch between gzip request and uncompressed response exhausts JDK Inflater resources.
items.reason_zh: gzip请求与未压缩响应之间的解压缩不匹配会耗尽JDK Inflater资源。

items.reason_en: Mutable @partial-block variable storage allows helper overrides, confusing template execution contexts.
items.reason_zh: 可变的@partial-block变量存储允许辅助函数覆盖，导致模板执行上下文混乱。

items.reason_en: Schema-controlled bytes fields generate unsafe JavaScript expressions during toObject conversion in protobufjs.
items.reason_zh: 受模式控制的bytes字段在protobufjs的toObject转换过程中会生成不安全的JavaScript表达式。

items.reason_en: Template imports key names lack validation applied to other options, enabling Function() constructor injection.
items.reason_zh: 模板导入键名缺乏对其他选项应用的验证，导致Function()构造函数注入漏洞。

items.reason_en: Lack of limits on user-supplied indirect buffer sizes in the AMDGPU driver risks out-of-bounds memory writes and privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: AMDGPU驱动中对用户提供的间接缓冲区大小缺乏限制，存在越界内存写入及权限提升风险。

items.reason_en: Forged SCTP cookie fields bypass authentication checks, enabling connection spoofing and potential denial of service.
items.reason_zh: 伪造的SCTP Cookie字段可绕过身份验证机制，从而导致连接欺骗及潜在的拒绝服务风险。

items.reason_en: Garbage collection freeing partially dead Unix socket connections can cause use-after-free vulnerabilities in the kernel networking stack.
items.reason_zh: 垃圾回收机制在释放部分失效的Unix套接字连接时，可能引发内核网络协议栈中的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞。
